test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the selling price of an article is 3 times the discount offered and if the percentage of the discount is equal to the percentage profit, find the ratio of the discount offered to the cost price.
solution:
**Given:**

The selling price of an article is 3 times the discount offered 

The percentage of the discount is equal to the percentage profit

**Concept used:**

Discount = MP − SP

D% = [(MP - SP)/MP] × 100

P% = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

**Calculations:**

SP = 3 × discount offered 

⇒ S.P = 3(MP − SP)

⇒ S.P = 3M.P − 3S.P

⇒ 4S.P = 3 M.P

⇒ M.P = 4SP/3

According to the question,

D% = P%

⇒ [(MP - SP)/MP] × 100 = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

⇒ [(4SP/3 - SP)/(4SP3)] × 100 = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

⇒ [(4SP - 3SP)/3 ÷ (4SP/3)] × 100 = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

⇒ 1/4 = (SP/CP) - 1

⇒ SP/CP = 1/4 + 1

⇒ SP = (5/4)CP

MP = 4/3 SP =(4/3)(5/4)CP = 5/3CP 

Now Ratio of discount to C.P

D/CP = (MP - SP)/CP

⇒ D/CP = (5/3CP - 5/4CP)/CP

⇒ D/CP = 5CP(1/3 - 1/4)/CP

⇒ D/CP = 5(4 - 3)/12 = 5/12

⇒ D : CP = 5 : 12

**∴ The ratio of the discount offered to the cost price is 5 : 12.**
